chunks: It is narrated that he became the deputy of Yazidi at Basra
and remained at his service a long while and collected large amounts of money.
who arrested him and confiscated the money
and gave him a blow at the top of his head, so hard that fluids of his brain came to his eyes.
Abu Bakr died in this way.

key_terms.لِلْيَزِيدِي: for the Umayyad governor (Yazid ibn al-Muhallab)

ai.seo_question: What happened to the false deputy who served Yazidi in Basra?
ai.summary: This narrative from *Kitab al-Ghayba* illustrates the ultimate fate of a false claimant to the Imam's deputyship who served under the Umayyad governor Yazidi in Basra. After accumulating significant wealth through his claimed authority, he was arrested, his property confiscated, and struck on the head until he died blind, serving as a cautionary tale for the Shia community regarding the authenticity of their representatives during the Minor and Major Ghaiba.
